items.title: 67246_Buck Clayton oral history interview
items.q: The interviewer mentions Jimmie Lunceford in the context of Coleman Hawkins and European tours; the interviewee (Buck Clayton) only agrees with the interviewer's general observation ('Yes, that's right') without providing personal anecdotes or confirming a direct professional relationship with Lunce

ctx.x: Now, this is the sort of thing that people over there remember you know. So Coleman Hawkins goes or somebody like that and Jimmie Lunceford went to Europe just once. Well people just sort of had the feeling well you'd better see him because who knows when he might be back? Whereas here, if Duke were playing in Newark we'll say, or Philadelphia and you'd already arranged to play bridge that night, you'd obviously think, well he'll be back six months from now.
